candidate.title: Resolve members by reflection at startup
candidate.rejectionReason: Reflection needs no generation step, which is its whole appeal, and it defers every version error to the moment a player triggers the hook. Ravel has to refuse an incompatible mod before a world opens, and a resolution failure discovered mid-game is the opposite of that. It also costs a lookup per resolution where a generated constant costs nothing.
